state.emptyText: No state display options for this entity type.
state.note: A domain with no entry in cards shows emptyText. The domain is the entity id's text before the first dot. Every row writes its key, never removes one, except the two size sliders' Auto, which removes the key.

stateVocabulary.narrowingRule: Without the entity's attributes nothing is narrowed. hvacModes: the rows are the entity's hvac_modes in their order, each lowercased, labelled from hvacModeLabels, else _ as spaces in Foundation's capitalized. featureBits: a listed row stays only when supported_features has one of its bits; an unlisted row always stays.
stateVocabulary.extraLabel: Every state that has an override (a key of stateIcons or stateColors) and is not in the rows is appended, sorted, labelled with _ as spaces in Foundation's capitalized.
stateVocabulary.write: stateIcons[state] and stateColors[state], state lowercased; a map left empty is removed; usesStateIcons is true while either map has an entry, else removed. The watch applies the maps only when usesStateIcons is true.

themes.note: Tile palettes (border, pattern and effect colors) show the page theme's expandedSwatchHexes from tile-defaults.json; the page Color palette its backgroundSwatchHexes; the page pattern and animation palettes patternSwatchHexes; the page title palette pageTitleSwatches (pageTitleSwatchHexes, then the first pageTitleBackgroundSwatchCount background swatches, duplicates dropped). A page with no known themeOverride shows swatchFallbackTheme's swatches.

resets.note: Each task's reset writes exactly these keys, null removing the key, on every tile it applies to; Page on the page. A page key that the encoder writes only under a condition (writeWhen in page-keys.json) is then not written. Reset Page clears the image keys like any other; the photo stays in Home Assistant's photo store until no page names it (the iPhone app also drops its own cached copy).

remap.rule: remapKnownThemeHex(hex, to): a gradient token is remapped end by end, an end that is not known kept (normalized). #000000 and #FFFFFF stay. A hex in roleByHex maps to the target theme's roleHexes for that role. Else, for each theme in themeOrder, for each list in indexLists, a hex found in that theme's list maps to the target theme's list at the same index, when the two lists are the same length. Else the hex is not known (null) and the caller keeps it. Hexes are compared upper case with a leading #.
remap.themeChange: On a theme change from the page's effective theme to another: every tile's color, animationColor, borderColor (not #THEME) and overlayColor (not #FFFFFF), and every group's overlayColor, take their remap when known; nothing of this when the two themes are the same. Then the page's backgroundColor takes its remap when known, same theme included. Then, on a page with useGradientColors, every tile color and animationColor that is not #RAINBOW is rebuilt as the gradient of its first color. Then themeOverride is written.
remap.gradientSwitch: Solid or Gradient: useGradientColors is written, and every tile color and animationColor that is not #RAINBOW takes the gradient form (a token stays as it is) or the solid form (a token's first color; a hex normalized).
